name: A final skull over the Wetlands

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

summary: Axtroz waits amid the windswept Wetlands, where rain and low cloud soften the coast. This final dragon trial completes the tribute demanded by Emberstrife. Across Kalimdor’s distant shores and the Eastern Kingdoms, each challenge has brought the adventurers nearer to the mountain. Now their road turns back to Blackrock, where Drakkisath waits.
